briefdescription.para: Get a pointer to an object of type T from the underlying stream, as if by memcpy, and store the result into Dest.

detaileddescription.para: It is up to the caller to ensure that objects of type T can be safely treated in this manner. Updates the stream's offset to point after the newly read object. Whether a copy occurs depends upon the implementation of the underlying stream.

simplesect.para: a success error code if the data was successfully read, otherwise returns an appropriate error code.

briefdescription.para: Read a VarStreamArray of size Size bytes and store the result into Array.

detaileddescription.para: Updates the stream's offset to point after the newly read array. Never causes a copy (although iterating the elements of the VarStreamArray may, depending upon the implementation of the underlying stream).

simplesect.para: a success error code if the data was successfully read, otherwise returns an appropriate error code.

simplesect.para: a success error code if the data was successfully read, otherwise returns an appropriate error code.
